page.overview:
What is Ctoggha?

Ctoggha, also known as the Dream Daemon, is a fictional entity created by Peter Schott for the German-language Call of Cthulhu supplement Die Goldenen Hände Suc'naaths und andere Abenteuer ("The Golden Hands of Suc'naath and other adventures.").

Little-to-nothing is known about the mysterious Great Old One Ctoggha, although it would appear likely that it has some connection to dreams or the Dreamlands.

Category:Great Old Ones Category:Characters Originating From Expanded Mythos Works
